Container.Name: PugetSoundMarineForecast
Container.Overview:
Marine weather forecast service for Puget Sound and Washington coastal waters. Fetches NOAA forecasts hourly, detects advisories/warnings, and serves them via a REST API, MCP server (for AI agents), and a built-in web dashboard.
Designed for boaters, sailors, and marine weather enthusiasts in the Pacific Northwest. Compatible with Home Assistant, Dakboard, and any REST client.
Container.Description: Puget Sound Marine Forecast — REST API, MCP server, and web dashboard for NOAA marine weather forecasts. Caches forecasts hourly with advisory detection.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and API

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: API key for authentication. Leave empty to disable auth (open access on local network).

Config.Name: Cache Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: How often to refresh forecasts from NOAA (in minutes).

Config.Name: Allowed Origins (CORS)
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins, or * for all.

Config.Name: MCP Server
Config.Description: Enable the MCP server endpoint for AI agent integration.
